title: BDD slice D: write the skill
item: Write the agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd skill from the café work, with its verify step
motivation: A slice of task 1, the BDD skill. Its content depends on what the slice before it shows.
notes: Verify step: script checks, the reference agent passes, then the mutation test of slice C. The probe agent of slice A is deleted. FOR THE BUILDER'S BRIEF (tasks/advice/052-1.md): tests/test_probe.py and tests/test_probe2.py use ProbeAgent and are edited, not deleted; probe/run_part2.py and probe/run_probe2.py stop working once it is gone, and the report says so. The old untracked file pytest-bdd-skill-notes.md is not part of this task: the owner had it deleted on 2026-11-20, since it described the spec format the café work replaced.
done_means: (1) .claude/skills/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/SKILL.md exists, written from the café example in .claude/skills/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/examples/cafe/, and its verify step names, in this order, the commands for: the drift check and the data-file checks (generate_features.py --check), the reference agent passing all 16 feature files, and the mutation test (variant_results.py --check, which reruns slice C's broken variants and compares each one's outcome with variant_results.json). (2) Each command the verify step names, run in the café folder, exits 0, and the whole café test suite passes. (3) The probe agent of slice A (class ProbeAgent in probe/agent.py and the --agent probe choice) is deleted, and the café suite and the commands of line 2 still pass without it.
draft_note: Placeholder written by Claude in chat on 2026-11-17 so the whole path of task 1 shows in the task list. done_means, verified_by and priority are left empty on purpose: Claude writes them from the results of the task this one depends on, and only then is it offered to the owner. Outline in tasks/plans/001.md, section 'Slices B to E'. On 2026-11-19 the manager drafted done_means, verified_by, may_edit and runs_as from task 51's results; the advisor ruled FAILS (tasks/advice/052-1.md) on a line retiring pytest-bdd-skill-notes.md, which no verifier can check while that file is untracked, so only the three lines it held are kept. On 2026-11-20 Claude in chat set priority and Ready on the owner's word of 2026-11-19 ("go"), and added the hard dependency on task 67, since both tasks edit the probe folder.

decided_for_you.chosen: RULING: FAILS (advisor job d), tasks/advice/052-1.md: lines on the skill's verify step, its commands passing, and deleting the probe agent hold; the line retiring pytest-bdd-skill-notes.md fails, since the file is untracked (no branch has it) and the builder's point-by-point account has no verifier. Kept the three lines it held.
decided_for_you.rejected: RULING: HOLDS with all four lines
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner commits pytest-bdd-skill-notes.md, names it in may_delete, and puts the point-by-point account in a file on the branch or gives the line a verifier that sees the builder's report; or the owner means the whole probe (prompt builder, runners, probe/agent.py) by 'the probe agent'; or 'script checks' includes the plan's clause map.

decided_for_you.chosen: RULING: FAILS (advisor job c), tasks/advice/052-2.md: with the probe-only tests cut, nothing tested that a run which raises still writes a verdict file with status error, so line (3)'s passing suite no longer proved that. A fresh builder added that test (commit c88df57).
decided_for_you.why: The removed test's usage check was probe-only, but its error-record check covered write_run code the branch rewrote.
decided_for_you.would_change: A test already asserting the error record, or the owner saying the error record existed only for the probe's money accounting.

decided_for_you.chosen: RULING: HOLDS (advisor job c), tasks/advice/052-3.md: with the new test, line (3) proves again that deleting the probe agent broke nothing else the suite checked.
decided_for_you.why: The new test checks every point the first ruling found unchecked, and the rest of the builder's decision was already sound.
decided_for_you.would_change: The new test failing or being weakened, or the owner meaning the whole probe by the probe agent.

decided_for_you.chosen: Builder: deleted the class ProbeAgent, the --agent probe choice and the conftest code that ran only for it; kept tools() (marked unused), to_messages(), the prompt builder and data.json's probe entries. probe/run_part2.py and probe/run_probe2.py no longer run, and their docstrings say so.
decided_for_you.why: The line names the class and the option, and DECISIONS.md has an agent propose rather than delete.
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner says the whole probe goes.

decided_for_you.chosen: Builder: the skill writes its output to bdd/ beside the spec folder or a folder the user names; tested moments are optional; the verify step is done_means' three commands, then the whole suite; judge cases are written but not run, since running them costs money.
decided_for_you.rejected: A fixed repo path; tested moments as a required step; the plan's clause map and fresh reader in the verify step; a paid step in the skill.
decided_for_you.why: Nothing in the repo fixes the output folder, and whether a real agent is gated from a tested moment is an open ruling of the owner's.
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner rules on tested moments, or slice E's blind run shows another output folder works better.

decided_for_you.chosen: Manager: the job (c) fix and the fix pass ran on the first review; the re-check (tasks/reviews/052-2.md) left three minor points open in that file: one more always-true llm_calls assert (tests/test_probe2.py:237), an ambiguous "(step 7)" pointer at SKILL.md:9, and checkers.md:38 calling judge_llm an ask_llm function when it builds one. No Proposed task from this run.
decided_for_you.rejected: A second fix pass; a Proposed task for the plain assert in variant_results.py (review 051-2) or for tasks/plans/001.md still listing the clause map in slice D.
decided_for_you.why: Rule 3 allows one fix pass, and the two earlier points change nothing the café suite or the skill does.
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner wants the three open points fixed, or the plan kept in step with done_means.
